Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a service offered by NPB Media, structured for display as a product card on the website. This entity stores details such as service name, descriptions, market value, and features, and aligns with the interactive services showcase and AI-assisted content summarizer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

name.description: The official name of the service or product offered by NPB Media (e.g., 'Custom Software Development', 'UI/UX Design').

description.description: A comprehensive and detailed description of the service, providing in-depth information. This field serves as the source text for the AI-Assisted Content Summarizer.

summary.description: A concise, AI-generated summary of the service's description, optimized for quick overviews on product cards and interactive showcases.

marketValueINR.description: The estimated market value or price of the service in Indian Rupees (INR), providing financial context for potential clients.

features.description: A list of key features, benefits, or deliverables included with the service, presented as bullet points on the product card.

imageUrl.description: An optional URL pointing to an image or icon that visually represents the service, enhancing the attractiveness of the product card.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product record was initially created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the product record was updated or modified.

definition.description: Stores details for each service offered by NPB Media, intended for public display on product cards and the interactive services showcase. Each document represents a single service (e.g., 'Custom Software Development'). This collection is designed for public read access.

params.name: productId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific product or service offering.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure for NPB Media's product offerings is a single top-level collection: `/products`. Each document within this collection will represent a 'Product' entity, detailing a specific service such as 'Custom Software Development' or 'UI/UX Design'. This design adheres strictly to the core principles for a secure, scalable, and debuggable Firestore structure.

**Authorization Independence:** This structure inherently achieves Authorization Independence. `Product` documents are designed to be public-facing, self-contained entities. Their access does not depend on data in parent documents or other collections (e.g., no `get()` calls are needed in security rules to determine if a user can view a product). If, in the future, administrative write access is implemented, it would be based on an independent check (e.g., `request.auth.uid` being present in an `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection), not on any attributes within the product document itself or its parent.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** This design fully supports Queryable Access Patterns (QAPs) for list operations. Since all documents in the `/products` collection are intended for public display (as implied by the 'Interactive Services Showcase' and product card requirements), a `list` query on `/products` will return all documents in the collection without requiring complex rule-based filtering. The security posture is homogeneous: all products are publicly readable. There is no mix of public and private/draft products within this collection, thus eliminating the need for security rules to act as data filters, which aligns perfectly with the QAP principle.
